jobs.description:
Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Spirii is looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer.

**If you are passionate about cloud software development, team collaboration, and creating outstanding backend code, join Spirii's fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working, including how we adopt AI to raise the quality and speed of our engineering.

As a Senior Backend Engineer in our Payments team within the Engineering department, you will help enhance the backbone of the Spirii platform that turns charging data into accurate invoices, credit memos, and payouts. It's a domain where correctness and financial data integrity are non-negotiable. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with CPH and near-shore colleagues, as well as Finance and partner teams.

What You Will Do

**Together With Your Team, You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure backend services and cloud-native queue-based pipelines (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript) that power data ingestion, processing, and invoice generation at high throughput.

• Ensuring data quality through correct aggregation and safe handling of late or updated records.

• Building and maintaining integrations with internal services and our ERP system.

• Significantly contributing to architectural decisions and solution design for cloud-native, distributed, event-driven systems on AWS.

• Driving automated testing and observability to protect billing correctness and catch data discrepancies early.

• Mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar of the team through code review, pairing, and constructive feedback.

• Operating independently on ambiguous, cross-team problems with minimal oversight.

• Using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate development and automate repetitive tasks while helping the team adopt AI safely in a financially sensitive codebase.

Who You Are

• Like to explore innovative technologies, including AI tools and agentic workflows, and continuously expand your skills.

• Ambitious and execution-focused, with strong ability to balance functional and non-functional requirements when designing solutions.

• A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex backend systems and actively maintaining operational awareness.

• Skilled at breaking down complex, ambiguous initiatives into vertical slices that deliver value incrementally; you default to shipping in small, regular batches rather than big-bang releases.

• Comfortable working in Agile, cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, Finance, partners), and an active participant in creating an open, collaborative environment.

• Excellent English communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization, internally and externally with partners/customers.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 7+ years of professional software development experience.

• Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling production backend systems, including having designed event-driven, queue/job-based architectures.

• Strong experience building TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js, NestJS) microservices on cloud platforms such as AWS.

• Experience leading design discussions, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical point of contact for a team or domain.

• Hands-on experience with test-driven development, test automation, integration and load testing.

• Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with the discipline needed for financially accurate, auditable data.

• Experience integrating external and internal IT systems, and solid API design.

• Experience with developing secure software is a plus.

• Knowledge of Redis and NoSQL databases is an advantage.

• Experience working with or integrating ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central) is an advantage.

• Experience with billing, payments, invoicing, or other financial/transactional systems is a strong plus.

• Hands-on experience using AI assistants and/or agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity is a plus.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Imagine a future where you shape how Trading & Revenue grows, works, and creates value by driving business-critical initiatives from idea to implementation.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Working hours full-time

Employment type Permanent

Legal entity Ørsted Salg & Service A/S

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll lead complex workstreams and contribute to cross-functional projects that strengthen Trading & Revenue. You’ll turn ambiguous challenges into clear plans, develop decision-ready insights, and work with senior stakeholders to move priority initiatives from initial framing through decisions and implementation.

Welcome to Commercial Enablement

You’ll be part of Commercial Enablement where you, together with your colleagues, will strengthen Trading & Revenue’s commercial development, business implementation, and planning capabilities alongside its broader operating model. The team delivers targeted strategic, commercial, and analytical projects in close collaboration with senior stakeholders across Trading & Revenue and the wider organisation.

As a team, we work with integrity, take ownership, and support each other. We combine clear structure, constructive challenge, and practical problem-solving to create lasting value.

You’ll play an important role in:

• building new business areas and value streams from initial problem framing and business plan development through to operational implementation

• shaping critical decisions by reviewing, challenging, and strengthening materials for senior leadership on topics such as market entry, commodity strategies, power purchase agreements, and complex transactions

• supporting Trading & Revenue performance management by bringing together financial results and key performance indicators and translating them into a clear executive narrative

• driving cross-functional initiatives from brief to delivery by creating structure, aligning stakeholders, managing milestones, and supporting implementation

• solving high-impact operational and process challenges by improving ways of working, documentation, governance, and cross-functional collaboration

• supporting business planning, capability roadmaps, priority setting, and resource allocation across a fast-moving commercial organisation

To succeed in the role, you:

• bring a strong problem-solving toolkit from consulting, commercial development, trading, origination, risk management, or equivalent experience

• can lead complex workstreams, create structure in ambiguity, and deliver outcomes through clear plans and disciplined follow-through

• communicate with clarity and credibility and can turn analysis into concise, decision-ready insights for senior stakeholders

• build trusted stakeholder relationships and challenge constructively while maintaining alignment and momentum

• thrive in collaborative environments, act with integrity, and work effectively across functions and levels of seniority

• are motivated by working close to the commercial engine and contributing to Trading & Revenue’s growth and digital ambitions

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be reviewing applications and conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

At Ørsted, we’re committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr63,200.00- kr94,800.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About Ørsted

**

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

• We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Scientists to join Project Systems department at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by turning complex project data into AI-powered insights and you thrive on taking ideas from prototype to production, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for two Senior Data Scientists with dedicated expertise in AI technologies to join our team in Project Systems supporting our Project Management area.

As a team, we are working on the data, systems and digital tools that support our customer pharma projects, all the way from design to handover of project documentation to the client. Your contribution will be important in turning that data into structure, insights and AI solutions that make our project execution smarter and more efficient.

You will work across the full AI lifecycle, from data preparation and machine learning to generative AI, large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, and help shape how NNE uses AI responsibly in a regulated pharma environment. This is your chance to become our go-to expert in AI and make a significant impact on the future of AI at NNE.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Data Scientist, you’ll be:

• 
Designing and deploying problem-solving AI and machine-learning solutions, from predictive models to generative AI and agent-based applications

• 
Analyzing and structuring data across the project lifecycle, and helping design AI solutions together with business users

• 
Driving AI initiatives from proof of concept (PoC) to production-ready solutions in collaboration with colleagues from Project Management and Global IT

• 
Acting as the link between business needs and IT data engineers, speaking both the IT and the business “language”

• 
Presenting trends, patterns and predictions to management and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and actionable way

• 
Driving responsible AI adoption by mentoring colleagues, setting best practices for MLOps and AI governance, and keeping us up to date with the latest AI advancements.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• 
Curious and innovative, with a genuine interest in technology and in putting new knowledge to use

• 
Pragmatic and solution-oriented, combining strong analytical skills with technical understanding

• 
Experienced in AI-assisted development with e.g Claude Code or Microsoft Copilot Studio.

• 
A clear communicator who can explain complex AI topics to colleagues, clients and management

• 
Comfortable working independently as well as collaborating with many stakeholders across disciplines and cultures

• 
Excited to share your knowledge, help others grow and build on the NNE culture of innovation

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• 
You have a master’s degree or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering or a related field

• 
You have 5–8 years of hands-on experience in data science, including taking machine-learning models from prototype to production

• 
You have strong programming skills in Python and SQL, and experience with ML frameworks such as scikit-learn or PyTorch

• 
You have practical experience with generative AI, such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Microsoft Copilot, Claude Code or Azure AI services

• 
You are fluent in written and spoken English, and Danish language skills are a plus.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 1 December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Martin Poulsen at +45 30 75 42 34.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Personal Care Assistant wanted for a woman with a brain injury in Rødovre – 1-2 days per week
jobs.description:
We are looking for a compassionate, reliable, and caring Personal Care Assistant to support a woman who recently returned home after rehabilitation.

She lives in a house in Rødovre with her husband and their two children. Following a cerebral hemorrhage, she has an acquired brain injury and paralysis on one side of her body. She has lost her ability to speak but understands English. Applicants must be able to speak English.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing personal care and daily support

• Assisting with transfers and everyday routines

• Being a calm, reassuring, and caring presence

Working hours:

• 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM

• 1-2 shifts per week

• Shifts alternate between Wednesdays and Fridays

• We work on a 6-week rotation, with both Wednesday and Friday shifts every sixth week

We offer:

• Immediate start

• A meaningful role where you can make a real difference

• The opportunity to work with a wonderful and kind family

• Support and introduction from an experienced colleague who previously worked with the woman and knows both her and the family very well

If interested please contact area manager: Julie Ngo, jun@oliviadanmark or at +45 61 10 04 64

Do you want to help ensure reliable documentation for electrical infrastructure projects? Can you bring structure to complex documentation flows and secure complete project records? And do you have at least five years of experience in document control? Then join COWI as our new Document Controller.

**Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Document Controller to join COWI and support our customer's electrical infrastructure projects. You will help ensure that both internal project documentation and supplier documentation are collected, organised and securely archived. Following an introduction to the relevant processes, methods and systems, you will work with minimal supervision to ensure complete project documentation through to final handover and project closure.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Set up archiving structures in the customer's electronic document and records management system and clarify which documentation must be collected and retained.

• Collect and secure internal project documentation from customer-managed SharePoint sites, as well as photographic documentation and other project records.

• Collect and secure supplier documentation, including collaborating with the customer's IT team on developing APIs or automation tools where needed.

• Ensure that final as-built documentation is complete, that projects comply with the customer's archiving guidelines, and that sites and platforms are closed down at project completion.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least five years of experience in document control.

• Experience with electronic document management (EDM) systems, an aptitude for IT and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

• Experience managing electronic workflows and as-built documentation.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English.

• A structured and thorough approach, enjoyment of process-oriented tasks, and a service-minded, collaborative and practical attitude. You are motivated and engaged, with a focus on helping projects succeed

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer - Revenue Enablement Group
jobs.description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for a senior engineer to help take it to the next level.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

**What You Will Do

**

• Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.

• Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.

• Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.

• Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.

• Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.

• Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.

• Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 5+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.

• Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language. Rust in production is ideal, but we'll also consider strong backend engineers who have built real things in Rust and want to go deeper.

• Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.

• Strong API design skills, and experience integrating with third-party APIs that don't always behave.

• Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.

• The judgement to make architectural calls and to improve a live system without stopping the business.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders, and you're comfortable bringing them along on technical trade-offs.

• A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code. You ask why before how, and you treat the platform's API and its internal users with the same care as an external product.

• Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to contribute meaningfully.

**Job Description

**The Data Platform IT team at Danske Bank is looking for a Cloud Platform Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve the Databricks platform that underpins data capabilities across the organization. Your work will shape the reliability and scalability of a platform used by engineers, architects, and data practitioners every day. In return, you will grow your skills in a collaborative environment with real technical depth.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will join a team of engineers and architects working on a platform that matters. The Data Platform IT squad operates with a high degree of technical ownership, and you will work closely with platform users, architects, and fellow engineers to translate real needs into self-service capabilities. The team values pragmatic thinking, open collaboration, and continuous improvement, and you will contribute to shaping how the platform evolves across environments.

**In your day-to-day work, you will:

**

• Design and build scalable capabilities on the Databricks platform across environments

• Develop automation using Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform

• Improve CI/CD and release automation using GitHub Enterprise Cloud and related tooling

• Build observability, monitoring, alerting, and automated remediation across the platform

• Implement security, identity and access management, and data governance capabilities

• Troubleshoot complex platform issues and contribute to stable production operations

• Collaborate with engineers, architects, and platform users to deliver self-service solutions

**About You

**

• Solid experience in cloud platform engineering, preferably on AWS

• Experience with Databricks or a comparable enterprise data platform

• Skilled with Infrastructure as Code tools, preferably Terraform

• Familiarity with CI/CD, version control, and software engineering practices including GitHub or Azure DevOps

• Experience with identity and access management, platform security, and governance controls

• Understanding of monitoring, logging, observability, and production platform operations at scale

• Clear communicator who collaborates across disciplines and takes pragmatic technical ownership

If you have experience in adjacent areas of cloud or data platform engineering, we welcome your application even if your background does not match every point above.

**What We Offer You

**You will be part of a team where your technical contributions make a tangible difference to the data capabilities of a major financial institution. We support hybrid working, with three to four days per week in the office to encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing. You will have access to learning opportunities and the chance to develop your expertise alongside skilled colleagues.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this role sounds like the right fit for you, please get in touch with hiring manager Vladimiras Cincikas at vlci@danskebank.lt with any questions, or apply directly through our careers page.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by the 27th of November, 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About Electricity Maps

**Electricity Maps is a VC-backed climate and energy tech start-up building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. We provide real-time, historical, and forecasted data on electricity systems worldwide - covering generation mix, electricity prices, carbon intensity, and renewable share.

Our data powers decisions across sustainability and energy markets: from companies like Google and Cisco optimising compute workloads and reporting emissions, to energy market participants using our forecasts to inform trading strategies and asset optimisation. We're a small, technical team based in Copenhagen, working at the intersection of energy, AI, climate change, and data.

**About The Role

**You'll work in the product team responsible for exposing our data to the world and you will help people and companies consume our data: Via our API, our map or whatever makes sense next.

We believe in engineers owning product decisions. Engineers scope the problem, build it and evolve it based on feedback from customers, colleagues and users. Those decisions usually aren't mapped out before you start on them so you're figuring out the shape of the problem and the best solution as you unpack it.

You'll be part of a small engineering team with 3 other full-stack engineers. No two days look the same. Most of your energy goes into building and figuring out solutions, with bug fixes and other tasks mixed in.

****What you'll do

• Build and ship across the stack (we’re using TypeScript for 95% of the product surface).

• Own the systems that touch customers directly, from how we onboard, guide and support them to how we serve data in the API they integrate with.

• Decide what to build in collaboration with leadership, sales, marketing and data teams.

• Care about your solutions being actually used and understand what matters to our users: dig deeper in analytics, join commercial conversations, be curious.

• Push on new ways customers can interact with our data. Maybe new API capabilities, new functionality in the map or something else.

• Dig into bugs and edge cases.

****What you won't do

• Ship something and never find out if anyone uses it.

• Wait around for permission to fix something you can see is broken.

• Spend more time in alignment meetings than building.

****What we're looking for

• 6+ years of hands-on experience shipping full-stack features in production and scaling them.

• Early-stage tech company / product experience.

• Product mindset, meaning that you build with the user in mind and have strong, defensible opinions on what "good" looks like; in code, in product, in process.

• Comfortable with data-heavy products, where edge cases and correctness can play a big part.

• Founder mentality, meaning that you are excited about building new products and taking them from an early stage to something users rely on. You spend time across the organization to deepen your knowledge and learn how users interact with the product to build things that are used.

****Our stack

****Relevant to this role: TypeScript, Node.js, React, GCP. The ideal candidate has worked in or close to these systems.

****The details

****Location: Copenhagen (office first, with flexibility)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options

Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at the office

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

**Job Description

**Are you driven by designing robust software architecture and solving complex system-level challenges in high-performance, real-time environments? Do you want to build systems that turn raw sensor data into precise and real-time metrics that golfers and broadcasters rely on?

At Trackman, we combine radar technology, computer vision, and data intelligence to redefine how golf is played, practiced and experienced. From local golf clubs to live TV broadcasts, our products set the global standard for accuracy, performance, and innovation.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to play a central role in architecting and evolving the software systems behind Trackman Range and Golf Broadcast.

In this role, you will design and own key parts of our real-time data processing platform, ensuring it is scalable, maintainable, and performant under demanding conditions. You will work at the intersection of software engineering and applied algorithms, translating mathematical models and signal-processing concepts into robust, production-grade systems.

You will be responsible for system-level design decisions, improving software architecture, and driving engineering quality across the codebase. This includes diagnosing complex system behavior, addressing performance regressions, and ensuring high standards of reliability, testability, and maintainability.

**Job Requirements

****The Ideal Candidate Has

**

• A master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field

• Strong expertise in C++ and Python, with a track record of building high-performance, production-grade systems

• Experience designing and owning scalable software architectures and real-time data processing pipelines

• Strong understanding of performance engineering, multi-threading, and system-level debugging (e.g., concurrency issues, performance regressions)

• Experience driving code quality, testing, CI/CD, and managing technical debt in production systems

• Experience with Linux-based systems for development, deployment, and debugging of distributed applications

• Experience with Docker for containerization and orchestration of those applications

• 5+ years of relevant experience with ownership of critical systems or components

**Other Valued Experience

**

• Radar technology, signal processing, numerical algorithms and sensor fusion

• Computer vision, tracking, and camera calibration

• Deep learning model implementation and optimization

• Real-time camera and video systems, including stream handling, data capture and encoding/decoding

• GPU acceleration and performance profiling

**The Office

**We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

**Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

**Where innovation happens

**At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

**Share our Passion!

**Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

**Job Description

**Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

About The Job Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React.

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

**Job Requirements

**Required skills:

• 3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills

• Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider

• Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication

• Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles

• Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset

• Experience with Git

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have):

• Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)

• Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product.

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

**The Office

**We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

**Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

**Where innovation happens

We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to build the customer-facing applications that allow our customers monitor the health of over one million connected devices and configure them on their own. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

Make an impact at device scale. You will work on our device health and device configuration applications: helping customers avoid non-reporting units and the downtime that comes with them, and putting device configuration in their own hands, so the right data reaches our platform. You will work with one of the most advanced IoT frameworks out there, side by side with product managers and product designers, and with AI as part of how our team builds.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Own your part. You drive your work from idea to production, make decisions yourself and push changes, supported by sparring partners.

• Work with AI every day. Our team has a shared AI development workflow, and AI is a daily part of how we build.

• Work closely with Product and Design. Your day-to-day partners are a product manager and a product designer, so your ideas turn into shipped features together.

• Learn and share. A frontend community, training, conferences and agentic development workflows, with learning at the centre.

• Grow over time. Through impact conversations, the community and your colleagues, with you as the main driver, in an international tech company that uses continuous integration and deployment.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a frontend engineer who ships, and is just as comfortable asking questions as making decisions.

• Hands-on experience with React (our main framework), Node.js and TypeScript, ideally on complex product environments. An IoT background is a plus, but we value navigating a complex domain more than any specific industry.

• You are results-driven: you ship features fast, dare to try, and are not afraid of asking questions, failing, or reaching out to people online or face to face.

• You work independently and take ownership: you show initiative, make decisions and follow your work through to production.

• You are a mix of technical expert and good communicator, able to explain your choices to product managers, designers and senior colleagues.

• Nice to have: GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP servers, backend exposure (Java, Spring Boot, Databricks, Postgres, AWS).

AI is part of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and a genuine interest in working with it matter more.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve our device health tools so customers avoid non-reporting units and the downtime that follows.

• Build self-service device configuration for customers, such as profiles that make sure the right data reaches our platform.

• Ship features fast, in close collaboration with product managers and product designers, and keep quality high with tests and code reviews.

• Look beyond the existing tools: avoid dead ends in device health and help create a more seamless experience across our device landscape.

• Share what you learn with our engineering community and talk about what the future brings in frontend.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial conversation with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other.

• Meet the hiring manager to talk through your experience and what drives you, in person where possible.

• Practical case that you prepare in advance and discuss with colleagues you will work closely with. The conversation matters more than the deliverable.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

ValueOne is recruiting a Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport for Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS. In this newly established role, you will be responsible for driving and developing the Group's strategic procurement activities within the logistics and transportation category. The position is physically based at the Danish subsidiary's office south of Copenhagen and reports to Head of Supply Chain Operations & Development. We welcome applications from candidates residing in both Sweden and Denmark.

About Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS

Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS is one of the Nordic region's leading distributors and brand partners within food, beverages, snacks, and confectionery. With more than 100 years of experience, the Group helps both international and proprietary brands grow across the Nordic markets through strong capabilities in marketing, sales, logistics, and category development. Supply Chain is regarded as a key competitive advantage, with a strong focus on customer and brand value while ensuring the right balance between service and cost. The company currently generates annual revenues of MNOK 4500 and employs approximately 400 people across the Nordic countries. Following an acquisition in 2026, Haugen-Gruppen has also established a presence in Poland and intends to continue expanding beyond the Nordic region.

About the Role

The Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport is part of the Nordic Supply Chain team and responsible for strategic sourcing and category management at Group level within transportation, third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse equipment, packaging materials and load carriers, and, where relevant, selected third-party manufacturing. The role works closely with stakeholders across the various markets to develop competitive and sustainable supplier solutions that strengthen Haugen-Gruppen's supply chain while ensuring the right service levels and total cost position.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and develop the Group-wide Logistics & Transport category strategy.

• Lead strategic sourcing and procurement initiatives across transportation, 3PL, warehousing, and related logistics services.

• Drive the Source-to-Contract process, including sourcing strategy, tendering, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.

• Develop and optimize Route-to-Market solutions in collaboration with Supply Chain and Commercial stakeholders.

• Manage supplier relationships, commercial agreements, and performance to ensure competitiveness, service excellence, and sustainability.

• Identify cost optimization opportunities through spend analysis, market intelligence, and supplier development.

• Mitigate supplier risk and ensure compliance with Group policies, standards, and sustainability requirements.

• Support strategic sourcing initiatives across adjacent supply chain categories when required.

Experience and Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field, alternatively equivalent relevant experience.

• Proven experience in strategic sourcing and category management managing suppliers and commercial agreements within indirect material and services.

• Strong commercial and analytical capabilities within spend analysis, tendering, negotiation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) assessment.

• Knowledge of sustainability requirements and compliance standards within logistics and procurement.

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Experience within logistics, transportation, supply chain, or FMCG environments is considered highly advantageous.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, analytical, and solution-oriented professional who enjoys working in an international environment. You have excellent communication and organizational skills and thrive when collaborating across functions, countries, and cultures.

A service-minded, flexible approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset will be essential for success in this role.

Application

We welcome your application for the position of Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For further information, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist James Li at James.Li@valueone.se.

About ValueOne

ValueOne specializes in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, and Logistics. We support our clients through three business areas:

• Interim Procurement and Supply Chain Consultants

• Recruitment of Procurement and Logistics Professionals

• Management Consulting

Through our consulting services, we help organizations develop and improve their procurement, logistics, and supply chain capabilities covering strategy, operating models, processes, organization, governance, and competence development.

**Why join us?

**Muuto is rooted in the Scandinavian design tradition characterized by enduring aesthetics, functionality, craftsmanship and an honest expression. By expanding this heritage with forward-looking materials, techniques and bold creative thinking, our ambition is to deliver new perspectives on Scandinavian design.

We are looking for a PR Intern to support Muuto’s global PR and brand activities and provide practical support to Channel Marketing. You will gain hands-on experience in branding, communication, press relations, and marketing support within an international design company. The internship starts as soon as possible, ideally for a period of six months or longer.

Working closely with the Global PR Manager and colleagues across the organization, you will help build awareness of Muuto and bring our designs and stories to the press and audiences across international markets. You will also assist the Channel Marketing team with defined tasks, helping keep presentations, marketing materials, and digital platforms up to date.

**The ideal candidate

**You are curious, structured, and proactive, with an interest in PR, communication, design, and interiors. You are eager to learn how PR works within a large international design company, from shaping stories and building brand awareness to supporting press relations and events.

You enjoy organizing and collaborating, and are happy to help with practical tasks. You bring attention to detail, a service-minded approach, and a willingness to learn while supporting several activities at the same time.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**As our PR Intern, you will support the Global PR Manager with daily coordination and execution and support the Channel Marketing team. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Support PR communication, including drafting and distributing press releases.

• Assist with press loans, influencer gifting, and contact updates.

• Support monthly PR tracking and KPI reporting.

• Help coordinate PR events, fairs, press meetings, and influencer activities.

• Keep PR materials and tools organized and up to date, and assist with ad hoc PR projects.

• Help update sales presentations and marketing materials using existing templates.

• Maintain marketing content and assets across digital platforms and support smaller Channel Marketing projects.

**Your profile

**

• An interest in PR, communication, and brand marketing, supported by relevant studies or practical experience.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach, with good organizational skills and an ability to follow up on tasks.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• A proactive, service-minded attitude and confidence communicating with internal and external contacts.

• A collaborative mindset and willingness to help with practical coordination and event support.

• Confidence working with presentations, documents, and spreadsheets.

• Curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks.

• An interest in design, interiors, lifestyle media, and influencer relations.

**What We Offer

**

• An internship based at Muuto’s Copenhagen headquarters, starting as soon as possible and ideally lasting six months or longer.
